backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining items, listings, transactions, and image storage with access control and functions for creating, updating, and retrieving listings.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping branding‑update requirements to affected frontend files and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining warm amber-themed OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up the root container and page title "Meyouu".
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup defining core application routes wrapped in the AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Component that restricts access to authenticated users and shows a sign‑in prompt when needed.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling authentication state and clearing cached queries on logout.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Layout wrapper providing consistent header and footer around all pages.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer displaying copyright for Meyouu and a referral link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with navigation, authentication controls, and a Meyouu-branded logo.
frontend/src/components/listings/DeleteL: Confirmation dialog for deleting a listing using a mutation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/listings/EditLis: Dialog for editing an existing listing using ListingForm and update mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Displays a listing card with status badge, title, and ICP price, linking to the listing detail page.
Form for creating or editing listings with validation, price conversion to e8s, and image URL handling.
frontend/src/components/purchase/Purchas: Purchase button handling authentication, ownership checks, confirmation dialog, and triggering purchase mutations.
frontend/src/components/states/QueryStat: Wrapper component that renders loading, error, empty, or content states for data queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a React Query-managed backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Exposes authentication state and helpers based on Internet Identity, including principal and login/logout actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider managing identity loading, login flow, and status tracking via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useListingMutations.t: React Query mutation hooks for creating, updating, deleting, and purchasing listings with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching listings, filtered listings, single listing, and user-owned listings.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes and UI element styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, rendering the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Displays all listings with a search box and filtered results, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/CreateListingPage.tsx: Provides an authenticated form to create a new listing and submits it via a mutation before navigating to My Listings.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single listing, including status, seller, price, and purchase options.
frontend/src/pages/MyListingsPage.tsx: Shows the authenticated user's listings with status indicators and edit/delete controls.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings and session storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, typography, animations, and content paths for the project.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature list, requirements mapping, and current project state version.
